title: Supplemental II - Assay Buffer for Hexokinase Activity and step-by-step guide for radiochemical filter paper assay for HK Activity Assay
author: Janne R. Hingst

steps_raw.instruction: Supplemental II - Assay Buffer for Hexokinase Activity and step-by-step guide for radiochemical filter paper assay for HK Activity Assay
HK affinity for G6P and 2-deoxy-glucose was investigated in the presence of increasing concentrations. Final concentrations of G6P were (0.1, 0.2, 0.5 and 1 mM).
* indicates that stock solution is stored at -30 °C. All other reagents were stored at +4 °C.
HEXOKINASE ACTIVITY ASSAY GUIDE
Dilute homogenate to 1-2 mg/ml in Homogenization Buffer. Heart and red muscles should be diluted to lower concentrations than white muscles.

Add 15 µl sample in 96-well PCR plate placed in a aluminum plate on ice. As controls, add 15 µl homogenization buffer, cold assay buffer (buffer without tracer) and a standard pool used to every assay. The standard enables for comparison when running more than one 96-well plate.

Start the kinase reaction: Put the 96-well PCR plate in a new aluminum plate on a 30 °C heating block. With a multichannel pipette, add 15 µl assay buffer to the designated wells and start a timer. Do not add assay buffer to the cold assay buffer.
Make sure that the assay buffer is placed in the bottom of the wells and that the homogenate and assay buffer are mixed appropriate.

Stop the kinase reaction after 15-25 min. at 30 °C (dependent on tissue and µg protein in the reaction) by adding 30 µl (1 vol) 90% EtOH (also to all the controls). Ensure full mixture by manual agitation.
Spot 20 µl in duplicates with a multichannel pipette on DE81 filter paper.
Wash 3x20 min. in excess 60% EtOH (e.g. 300 ml in 31 cm x 22 cm x 6 cm box).
The filter paper dries in the fume hood.
Spot assay buffer (2x1 µl and 2x2 µl) directly on the filter paper. In order to determine specific activity, spot 3x3 µl and 3x6 µl in vials with 4 mL UG scintillation liquid.
When the DE81 paper is dry, cover it with plastic wrap and put in a cassette.
Count in the in a Phosphorimager after 48 hours.
Calculate the activity (µmol/g protein/min):
= 3.6 µmol/g protein/min
